features.pain_removed: A coach adds a whole squad at training without typing anyone's email.

features.name: Coach invites athlete by email
features.what_it_does: The coach adds an athlete by email. The athlete receives a branded 'Set your password' invite link, and the roster shows them as PENDING until they first log in.
